content:
[Intro]
[F#]
[C#]
[Badd9]

[Verse 1]
[F#]If it makes you less sad
I will die by your hand
[C#]Hope you find out what you want
Already know what I am
[Badd9]
[F#]And if it makes you less sad
We'll start talking again
[C#]You can tell me how vile
Already know that I am
[Badd9]

[Pre-Chorus]
[F#]I'll grow old
Start acting my age
[C#]Be a brand new day
In a life that you
[Badd9]hate
[F#]A crown of gold
A heart that's harder than stone
[C#]And it hurts a whole lot
But it's missed when it's
[Badd9]gone

[Chorus]
[F#]Call me a safe bet
[C#]I'm betting I'm not
[Badd9]
[F#]I'm glad that you can forgive
[C#]Only hoping as
[Badd9]time goes,
you can forget

[Solo]
[F#]
[C#]
[Badd9]

[Verse 2]
[F#]If it makes you less sad
I'll move out of the state
[C#]You can keep to yourself
I'll keep out of your way
[Badd9]
[F#]And if it makes you less sad
I'll take your pictures all down
[C#]Every picture you paint
I will paint myself out
[Badd9]

[Pre-Chorus]
[F#]It's cold as a tomb
And it's dark in your room
[C#]When I sneak to your bed
To pour salt in your
[Badd9]wounds
[F#]So call it quits
Or get a
[C#]grip Say you wanted a so-
lution You just wanted to be
[Badd9]missed

[Chorus]
[F#]Call me a safe bet
[C#]I'm betting I'm not
[Badd9]
[F#]I'm glad that you can forgive
[C#]Only hoping as
[Badd9]time goes,
you can forget

[Interlude]
[F#]
So you can for-
[C#]get
You can for-
[Badd9]get

[Break]
[F#]You are calm and reposed
Let your beauty unfold
[C#]Pale white, like the skin stretched
over your bones
[Badd9]Spring keeps you ever close
You are secondhand smoke
[F#]You are so fragile and thin
Standing trial for your sins
[C#]Holding on to yourself
the best you can
[Badd9]You are the smell before rain
You are the blood in my veins

[Chorus]
[F#]Call me a safe bet
[C#]I'm betting I'm not
[Badd9]
[F#]I'm glad that you can forgive
[C#]Only hoping as
[Badd9]time goes,
you can forget
[F#]
